item.title: 10.3.0 | Terrifier Patch Notes
item.description:
Content
New Killer: The Terrifier

POWER: BAG OF TOYS
Hold the Ability Button to open the Bag of Toys and choose from 2 Toys. New Toys are randomly available each time the bag is opened. Closing the bag triggers a 10s cooldown.

item.description:

  • Added fluid system contents and flushing functionality to the pipe GUI.
  • Added search to the 'Select planet to drop to' GUI.
